deadline.value: Fall admission deadline is March 1 for full consideration; late applications are still considered.

gre_general.value: Recent (within three years) GRE General scores are required.
gre_general.quote: Recent (within three years) GRE scores (only the general exam is required)

gre_subject.value: Only the general GRE is required; the Mathematics Subject test is not.
gre_subject.quote: only the general exam is required

toefl_min.value: The department page gives the old-scale TOEFL iBT 79, which predates the January 2026 change; the new-scale value is not confirmed.

ielts_min.value: The department also asks for an IELTS overall band of at least 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: English proficiency can also be met by submitting official IELTS scores of at least 6.5 overall band score

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty member must agree before admission.

funding.value: The applicant states interest in a GTA position in the cover letter; the catalog gives no funding guarantee.

entry_route.value: Undergraduate coursework equal to a mathematics major is the stated preparation.
entry_route.quote: Interested applicants should have completed undergraduate coursework equivalent to a major in mathematics from an accredited university

notes: Source: the 2026-27 graduate catalog Mathematics, Applied and Industrial PhD section. Spring deadline (November 1) is not for Fall 2027 and is not recorded.
